name: Conveyor
summary: A multi-file upload queue where each file rides a factory belt, gets stamped SENT and drops into the cloud
about: Conveyor shows an upload queue as a little factory line. Every file you add becomes a cardboard parcel on the belt and a row in the list; as each one uploads the belt, chevrons and rollers move with its progress until the press slams a SENT stamp on it and it tips into the cloud chute. Files over 25 MB are refused, a dropped connection can be retried from where it stopped, and the last parcel sets off confetti.
how: Press Add files (or drop files anywhere on the card); image rows show real thumbnails and big files are refused.
Remove any waiting file with its X, then press Upload all.
Each parcel rides the belt with its progress, gets stamped and drops into the cloud; the footer adds up files and MB.
If a file drops its connection press Retry to carry on from the same percent; Clear sent tidies the list.
